sentiment: Someone planted seeds they could not name, and the waiting was most of the act.

stories.title: An Italian farmer found some unknown seeds in his attic and planted them
stories.summary: A jar in an attic, no label, no promise — and the decision to put it in soil anyway. Nearly everything worth having starts as an unidentified seed and a person willing to be wrong.

stories.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
stories.summary: A recommendation feed rebuilt out of what people actually chose to share. Taste handed forward by hand, one link at a time, instead of guessed by a model that never had to like anything.

stories.title: Running a bootstrapped SaaS for 20 years with my brother
stories.summary: Twenty years, 766 million files, two brothers still answering the mail. Longevity is not a strategy you announce; it is the residue of showing up on the days nothing happened.
